placebo.method: funding features permuted across entry origins per symbol, identical pipeline

fit_scope: per-scenario models; pooled = equal-weight mean of per-scenario delta_brier

floor_evaluation.rule: B1 or B2 beats B0 (delta_brier>0, CI95 lower>0) in >=2/3 holdouts on L10|long|H24 AND |real mean| > |placebo mean|

honest_status: EXPLORATORY/PILOT. Modeled boundary breaches only; not observed liquidations. Three chronological holdouts with 7-day purge/embargo; stdlib per-scenario logistic; UTC-day block bootstrap; funding-permutation placebo. No confirmatory claim.
